test_causal_eval_evaluate: test causal_eval.evaluate to run RASP programs with causal masking on input sequences
test_constant_selector: test rasp.ConstantSelector to create a fixed boolean selector matrix for RASP evaluation
test_causal_evaluator_class: test CausalEvaluator class to evaluate RASP selectors with lower-triangular causal masking
test_parameterized_evaluations: test parameterized evaluations of causal_eval.evaluate with multiple constant selector configurations
test_causal_mask_application: test causal masking applied to selector outputs using np.tril logical_and on boolean matrices
